title: OpenAI trains advanced AI models without internet access
excerpt: OpenAI now trains its top AI models offline using cached web content to prevent external security risks.
body_html:
OpenAI has changed its training methods for its most advanced artificial intelligence models by removing internet access during the training process. The update follows previous hacking incidents that prompted the company to reevaluate its security measures.

According to a company blog post, engineers developed a specialized offline testing environment. This setup allows the AI models to interact safely with indexed and cached web content. By using this isolated system, the company can continue model training without the risk of impacting external networks or systems.
